title: Strategic realignment: ops runs itself, Claude effort goes to research (hypotheses, learning, the AI trader)
note: OPERATOR 2026-10-13 ~07:30Z (strategic planning session) verbatim, framing: 'we have most of our infra built out and stable ... our big gap here is the quality of our actual trading strategies ... realigning our workflow so that most of the regular ops work can happen through the system itself ... limit [Claude ops effort] to verifying the system's reporting and debugging as needed ... separate from new feature builds ... The lion's share of our direct effort should be going into research to improve the system's outcomes (basically, overall pnl) ... estimate how much actual claude power is needed for [ops] ... how much claude power we have per week for the main task ... the most robust research and testing system and workflow ... research>testing>implementation>iteration ... a clear process strategy/doctrine ... Hypothetically, I would want the system to be able to keep going without me indefinitely - researching, testing, implementing, improving - based on clear goals and instructions.' DECISIONS ~07:50Z verbatim: (1) 'I like having the manager session, and I think it's important that it stay on Opus ... Perhaps what we need is for the manager to also keep an assistant manager sonnet lane for managerial tasks that don't require opus (routine supervision).' (2) 'direct claude resources towards hypothesis sourcing and learning ... even these tasks have subtasks which can and should be automated ... claude should be as focused as possible on improving the strategy performance and building the AI trader as opposed to ongoing ops work.' (3) GOAL: 'optimize for net PNL (including prop accounts, which should be graded against return on the initial purchase) - we only have the daily dd right now to worry about'. (4) AUTONOMY: 'The system is already allowed to make tier 2 and 3 decisions autonomously if they are backed by data, but we can refine and expand these permissions'. (5) BUDGET split accepted as a starting point: ~10% ops monitoring / ~20% builds / ~70% research. (6) 'a big part of this review - planning any and all functions that could be automated to take the pressure off the claude budget'. Workstreams: OPS-AUTOMATION-INVENTORY (lane), ASSISTANT-MANAGER (Sonnet supervision lane), RESEARCH-DOCTRINE (draft with the operator). [basis] The ~10%/~20%/~70% figures are TARGET shares of the weekly Claude allowance (operator-accepted starting split), to apply from the week 2026-10-14 through 2026-10-21; they are not measurements. The measured split is being built by OPS-AUTOMATION-INVENTORY over the window 2026-09-29 through 2026-10-13. [2026-10-13 ~08:15Z OPERATOR DECISIONS on the doctrine draft https://claude.ai/code/artifact/0e6c1dc7-85fd-4648-976e-3617401eebe1, verbatim] Exploration: 'I just want to verify that our research flow includes broad open ended research sessions to find new and novel ideas, not just to refine the ones we already have'. Real money: 'the system can clear the full ladder without me, and that shouldn't impact the sizing either - it's just about having the evidence to back up the decisions'. Research mix: 'Looks good for now, I would want to be able to devote more to AI and frontier, but based on capacity'. Prop: 'no, in the end of the day the nominal PNL is the guiding principle for all system features'. Demotion: 'shouldn't be measured in time, it should be measured in confidence, and we need to stop using the word kill, as it implies that there isn't an entire iteration process downstream of demotion (which there is and should be)'. Breadth vs depth: 'We really need both here, not sure how to quantify relationally' (manager proposal in the doc: 40% exploration / 60% refinement of research budget, rebalanced weekly by yield, to be confirmed at weekly planning). Markets: 'I want us to maximize PNL within the technical limitations of our setup (and we can always build out when justified) - this is about trading, not investing, so it's not about what I believe in, it's about our ability to predict price and maximize gains'. LANGUAGE RULE (binding): strategies are demoted / retired to research / iterated, never 'killed'. FOLLOW-UPS: (a) schedule recurring open-exploration research sessions at the 2026-10-14 weekly planning; (b) real-money promotion mandate: remove any reduced-size clause so sizing follows normal rules, Tier-3 config change to be prepared by a lane against config/mandates.yaml; (c) demotion mandate to be expressed as a confidence bar, not a time window; (d) commit the agreed doctrine to docs/plans/ once settled. [2026-10-13 ~08:20Z OPERATOR verbatim] 'we may even want to use Fable for the more complex research sessions'. Note: Fable runs on its own weekly limit (70% used at 05:12Z, resets Wed ~17:59Z), separate from the all-models pool, so complex research sessions on Fable also add capacity. To be set in the 2026-10-14 weekly planning: which session classes run on Fable (candidates: open exploration, hypothesis design, research-result synthesis/ledger writing). [2026-10-13 ~08:38Z OPERATOR, paraphrase of a voice message] Also review the architecture and resources (mainly compute) and make sure they are allocated optimally for the refocus: consolidate training onto one VM if possible to free capacity for research; find free or acquirable resources (Hugging Face and other open-model sources, both for sourcing and for compute); the VMs stay as they are for the continuous pipelines, but bursty research may belong elsewhere; GPU bursts should be part of the workflow. Dispatched lane COMPUTE-ARCH-REVIEW (session_01KKBMQzaGaDYCtbtCskjDJk, Sonnet, ceiling $5, read-only): current compute map, workload map, free resources, ranked recommendations. [2026-10-17 RESEARCH-AUTHOR-GRADE-1017] Workstream state on main f03d9032: OPS-AUTOMATION-INVENTORY row landed_unproven (docs/plans/OPS-AUTOMATION-INVENTORY-2026-10-13.md exists); COMPUTE-ARCH-REVIEW doc exists (docs/plans/COMPUTE-ARCH-REVIEW-2026-10-13.md; follow-on rows COMPUTE-GH-FIRST/HF-SOURCING/GPU-WIRE/KAGGLE-GPU exist); ASSISTANT-MANAGER has no row but is live in practice (.claude/skills/manager/SKILL.md lines ~737-739: review and health routines bound to the assistant-manager session). RESEARCH-DOCTRINE had NO row and no committed doc; filed now as row RESEARCH-DOCTRINE. The umbrella is blocked on that one item. The 2026-10-21 observation (all three workstreams landed) cannot be met until the doctrine doc is committed.
